macfuse.name: MacFUSE
macfuse.description: ファイルシステムユーザー空間フレームワーク、ntfs-3gに必要
macfuse.installGuide: MacFUSE is the foundation for NTFS mounting. Intel Macs: sudo port install macfuse. Apple Silicon: brew install --cask macfuse. Allow the system extension after installing.

ntfs3g.name: ntfs-3g
ntfs3g.description: NTFSファイルシステムドライバー、NTFS読み書きサポートを提供
ntfs3g.installGuide: Install ntfs-3g to mount NTFS volumes read-write. Intel Mac: sudo port install ntfs-3g (installs MacFUSE automatically). Apple Silicon: brew tap gromgit/homebrew-fuse && brew install ntfs-3g-mac

help.title: ガイド

quickStart.1: 1. On the Dependencies tab, confirm MacFUSE and ntfs-3g are installed. Expand an entry to see install commands.
quickStart.2: 2. On the NTFS Devices tab, click "Mount" on the target device and approve the system authorization prompt.
quickStart.3: 3. The volume appears under /Volumes and is now writable. Use "Unmount" to return it to read-only.

macPorts.1: Intel Macs have no official Homebrew support, so use MacPorts (installed in /opt/local):
macPorts.2: This app automatically detects executables under /opt/local/bin — no extra configuration needed.

help.troubleshooting: トラブルシューティング

about.1: NTFSMount is a native macOS app for reading and writing NTFS volumes, powered by macFUSE + ntfs-3g.
about.2: 技術スタックは SwiftUI + IOKit + DiskArbitration です。インターフェース、デバイス検出、マウント処理はすべてシステムフレームワークで構成されており、サードパーティのランタイムは使用していません。
about.3: Device detection uses native system APIs (IOKit / statfs); idle CPU usage is near zero.

help.trouble.1: • "Windows is hibernated": Windows Fast Startup is on. Plug the drive back into Windows and run shutdown /s /t 0 to fully shut down.
help.trouble.2: • "Resource busy": a program is using the device. Use the "Reset" action, or close the program and retry.
help.trouble.3: • "ntfs-3g not found": verify it is installed and that /opt/local/bin (MacPorts) or /usr/local/bin is in the search path.
help.trouble.4: • Permission denied: allow the MacFUSE system extension in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
